public.title: Word Search II
public.description: Find all distinct dictionary words that can be formed by a path through a lowercase ASCII board, moving only up/down/left/right and never reusing a cell within one word. Return found words once each in lexicographic order. Rectangular dimensions are 0 to 6; dictionary contains 0 to 100 words, each length 1 to 8. Duplicate dictionary entries are allowed.
hints: Search each word with a visited set local to the current path.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Backtracking explores neighboring cells while forbidding reuse. Deduplicate and sort successful words. For W words of length L, worst-case time is O(W times cells times 4 to the L).
